transcript_raw: Chibai le Sir, Aizawl atangin Lalrinmawii ka lo bia che a. Ka saving account atanga vawiina electric bill leh tui bill ka pek kha vawi hnih a in-cut palh a, min lo enfiah sak thei em? Aw, ka account number tawp lam nambar pali chu panga bial sarih riat a ni a, zing dar sawmah khan UPI hmangin sanghnih leh zanga ka thawn a ni. Tunah hian Dawrpui bazar bul thingpui dawrah ka thu mek a, hla play ri leh motor horn ri a ring deuh maithei a, min lo ngaithla thei tho em? Transaction hmasa zawk kha pending a inti reng a, a pahnihna kha successful a ni thung si a, engtikah nge pawisa chu a lo let leh ang? Chuan ka credit card statement hi thla tin email-ah ka dawng thin a, mahse thla hmasa khan ka dawng miah lo a, ka email ID kha a dik em? Ka debit card international transaction hi online course fee pek nan vawiin atan chauh min lo hawn sak theih chuan ka lawm ngawt ang. Aw le Sir, mobile banking app chhungah card settings atangin keimah pawhin ka on leh off thei tih ka lo hre reng reng lo a, ka ti nghal ang. UPI refund complaint number chu SMS-in ka phone-ah a lo thleng chiah e, ni thum chhungin ka account-ah a lo lut leh dawn tihna a ni maw? E-statement pawh ka email-ah tunah khan a lo lut nghal e, ka hmu thei ta e. Ka lawm lutuk e Sir, min puihna zawng zawngah ka lawm takzet, mangtha le.
